svg.title: Supply and graduation
svg.desc: 800 million tokens from the launch price to the graduation price, then 200 million above it. Graduation is a flag, with no migration.
svg.text: ONE BILLION TOKENS, LOCKED IN TWO POSITIONS

g.text: A flag flips, and that is all. No migration, no new pool, no liquidity moves.

svg.text: The pool's LP fee is 0, and the hook takes the tax. Nothing can remove this liquidity.
Quote is always currency0, so one set of curve maths serves every pair.
